scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -k -n server,web "npm run dev -w @navloom/server" "npm run dev -w @navloom/web"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev -w @navloom/server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev -w @navloom/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck -w @navloom/server && npm run typecheck -w @navloom/web
scripts.test:server: npm run build:contracts && npm run test -w @navloom/server
scripts.build:agent: cd agent && mkdir -p bin && go build -o bin/navloom-agent ./cmd/navloom-agent
